apply_colwise_tp: split a linear layer weight matrix column-wise across tensor parallel ranks for distributed inference
apply_rowwise_tp: split a linear layer weight matrix row-wise across tensor parallel ranks for distributed training
apply_embedding_tp: partition an embedding layer weight matrix across tensor parallel ranks for distributed model sharding
reduce_from_tensor_model_parallel_region: all-reduce a tensor across the model parallel group to aggregate outputs from sharded layers
disable_compiler: wrap a function with torch.compiler.disable to bypass torch.compile for accuracy-sensitive operations
